studies.title: Experiences of autistic transgender and gender diverse adults undergoing gender-affirming hormone therapy and the influence on occupational identity outcomes.
studies.authors: Miller SL, Bourke-Taylor H, Dixon K et al.
studies.preview: Autistic transgender and gender diverse (TGD) adults often report additional barriers to health-care access and occupational participation. Gender-affirming hormone therapy (GAHT) consists of hormonal medications a person may choose to take to increase alignment of physical features with their gender identity.

studies.title: Rapid Review of the Brief Observation of Social Communication Change (BOSCC) Shows It Can Detect Behavioural Changes in Social Communication in Autism.
studies.journal: Autism : the international journal of research and practice
studies.authors: Howlin C, Kovalova A, Jaschke A et al.
studies.preview: Reliable measurement of social communication change remains a major challenge in autism research. The Brief Observation of Social Communication Change (BOSCC) was developed to detect subtle changes in communication.

studies.title: Longitudinal predictors of internalizing and externalizing behaviors in autism: Examining relationships with ritualistic behavior and social diagnostic features.
studies.authors: Surmacz M, Coffman MM, Faja S et al.
studies.preview: Autistic youth commonly experience co-occurring mental health conditions. Core autism features have been linked to internalizing and externalizing symptoms, yet longitudinal pathways remain unclear.
